notes.title: optimizes the new player guidance process, fixes bugs
notes.content: [h1]✨ New Player Guidance Optimization[/h1][list][*][p][b]Added Ink Spending Guidance[/b]: New players will receive guidance on rational ink consumption after completing the first playthrough[/p][/*][*][p]​[b]Starter Fund Reward[/b]: 40 additional ink rewarded as initial development fund after first playthrough completion[/p][/*][*][p][b]Academy Upgrade Guidance[/b]: New guidance steps to help players understand the importance and operation of academy upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]​[b]Mythic Literature Drawing Guidance[/b]: Guides players to use ink for drawing mythic literature to enhance combat capabilities[/p][/*][*][p]​[b]Character Customization Guidance[/b]: Added character creation workflow guidance to help players create personalized characters[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed issue where collecting small suns at 【Summer Returns】 level 10 didn't trigger Force Barrage[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game freeze issue caused by still being able to answer questions after battle when using 【53】[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where 【Trade Guild】 College occasionally refreshed two identical spells in the shop[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1]⚖️ Balance Adjustments[/h1][p align="start"]​[b]Unlock Progression Changes:​[/b]​[/p][list][*][p]Some initially unlocked books moved to later progression[/p][/*][*][p]【Engineering】 unlocked after first playthrough completion[/p][/*][*][p]【53】 unlocked after first playthrough completion[/p][/*][*][p]【Rainbow Page】【Photosynthesis Page】 unlocked after first playthrough completion[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]​[b]Skill Effect Adjustments:​[/b]​[/p][list][*][p]【Arcane Page】mana cost reduction decreased from 100% to 60%[/p][/*][*][p]【Arcane Page】Additional mana consumption for shields and ultimates now calculated based on current mana instead of maximum mana[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: inflation mechanism adjustments, bug fixes, and balance tweaks
notes.content: [h1]⚡ Performance Optimizations[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed instant lag caused by mass buff application/removal[/p][/*][/list][h1]💰 Inflation Adjustments[/h1][list][*][p]Redesigned shop pricing formula[/p][/*][*][p]Now calculates based on current crystal count (instead of historical maximum)[/p][/*][*][p]Price scaling based on crystal holdings:[/p][list][*][p]<2000: No inflation[/p][/*][*][p]2000-20k: Slight price increase[/p][/*][*][p]20k-1M: Moderate price increase[/p][/*][*][p]1M-10M: Drastic price inflation[/p][/*][*][p]10M: Cannot purchase more items with more crystal (for those extreme players!)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h1]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed duplicate faction burning options[/p][/*][*][p]Burned factions no longer appear in selection[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed opposing factions still being burnable under Focus Magic[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected English localization for 【Grandfather Paradox】[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 【Quantum Mechanics】 incorrectly targeting 【Crystal Shards】 in auto-aim mode[/p][/*][/list][h1]⚖️ Balance Changes[/h1][list][*][p]Faction burning options increased from 2 to 3 choices[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial mode now provides base HP regen to reduce new player deaths[/p][/*][*][p]【Quantum Mechanics】+auto-aim now calculates nearest enemy from clone position (not main body)[/p][/*][/list][h1]🌌 Endless Mode Adjustments[/h1][list][*][p]Purchasing passive spells slightly reduces their shop refresh chance (resets at next stage)[/p][/*][*][p]Passive fragment stage rewards unaffected[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Thank you for your continued support! We'll keep working to bring you a better gaming experience.[/p]

notes.title: v1.0.3.5 Weekly Update Announcement
notes.content: [p]Dear Players,[/p][p align="start"]We are delighted to bring you the v1.2.0 update for Book Shooter! This update introduces an auto-aiming feature, optimizes game performance, fixes multiple bugs, and includes balance adjustments. Below are the detailed update notes:[/p][p][/p][p]✨ New Features[/p][p align="start"]【Auto-Aiming System】[/p][list][*][p]Added auto-aim toggle in the 【Options Panel】[/p][/*][*][p]When enabled, mouse hovering over your spellbook in combat will automatically target the nearest enemy[/p][/*][*][p]Does not work with special spellbooks (e.g., Burning Steel, Engineering)[/p][/*][*][p]Will attempt to fire all equipped shoot spells even if auto-cast is disabled[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]⚡ Performance Optimizations[/p][list][*][p]Improved performance when opening 【Magic Book】 panel with too many spells[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed performance issues caused by excessive 【Black Hole】 stacking[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced computation interval for high-frequency effects, improving overall smoothness[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized lightning strike visual effects:[/p][list][*][p]Reduced particle count[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered visual intensity when disappearing[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Improved snowman and magic crystal generation/conversion logic, significantly reducing lag[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]🐞 Bug Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed potential errors during character refresh[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized logging system to exclude irrelevant information, improving performance[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified font animation implementation and fixed related errors[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed potential errors when returning to main menu after defeating a Boss[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemies getting stuck at screen edges making them unbeatable[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed temporary collision detection failure for enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 【Space Circle】 enemy gathering effect being affected by player range[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed specific units (Sow, Turrets) still triggering hover effects at max level[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed display issues with certain turret summons[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]⚖️ Balance Adjustments[/p][p align="start"]【Engineering】[/p][list][*][p]Maximum deployed turrets reduced to 30[/p][/*][*][p]Gain +1 turret capacity every 7 levels[/p][/*][*][p]Exceeding capacity now triggers 3 waves of force barrage and grants +3 permanent EXP[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]【Visual Effects】[/p][list][*][p]【Shining Angel】 and 【Anti-Magic Demon】 no longer cause screen darkening[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]【Magic System】[/p][list][*][p]【Spell Research】 purchases no longer reduce random player properties (slightly lowered bonuses instead)[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reduced 【Passive】 spell refresh rate, increased 【Spell Research】 refresh rate[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]【Stage Rewards】[/p][list][*][p]Adding rare properties in bonus stages no longer increases enemy HP[/p][/*][*][p]【Small Chest】 and 【Rare Chest】 rewards now scale with player level[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]【Endless Mode】[/p][list][*][p]Significantly reduced enemy attack power growth rate[/p][/*][*][p]Still has chance to spawn white and blue magics in shop[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]【UI Improvements】[/p][list][*][p]Reduced waiting time for score display and confirm button in stage completion screen[/p][/*][*][p]Increased auto-cast tooltip text size on skill icons[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Thank you for your continued support! We'll keep working to bring you a better gaming experience.[/p]

notes.title: Performance Optimization & Balance Update
notes.content:
[p]Dear readers, to provide a smoother gaming experience and more balanced gameplay, we've conducted comprehensive performance optimizations and numerical adjustments. Here are the details of this update:[/p][p][/p][h3]Performance Optimization[/h3][p]​[b]​+ Projectile System Optimization[/b]​[/p][list][*][p]Removed physics interactions between bullets, essentially eliminating lag caused by \[excessive bullets, oversized volumes, scatter/salvo/rapid fire][/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted particle counts for certain visual effects to reduce performance overhead[/p][/*][*][p]Removed some glaring visual effects to improve visual comfort[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]​[b]​+ Summon Limits[/b]​[/p][list][*][p]\[Skeleton Archers] now have a maximum limit - exceeding this limit will instead increase duration of all existing skeleton archers[/p][/*][*][p]\[Little Devil] and other common summons will also have quantity limits to prevent late-game lag[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][p]​[b]​+ Bullet System Fixes[/b]​[/p][list][*][p]Fixed issue where oversized bullets could cause colliders to go outside map boundaries[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bullet detachment issue caused by excessive attack speed[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Numerical Adjustments[/h3][p]​[b]​+ Economy Rebalance[/b]​[/p][list][*][p]Readjusted game economy curve to prevent players from easily emptying shops in late-game[/p][/*][*][p]\[Postpartum Pig Care] reduced crystal yield from growth states[/p][/*][*][p]\[Crystal Extraction] magic no longer works on magic crystals to prevent infinite crystal exploits[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]​[b]​+ Attribute Balancing[/b]​[/p][list][*][p]\[Recharge], \[Frequency], \[Memory], \[Fortune], \[Discount], \[Pjt Spd] properties now use smoother value curves[/p][/*][*][p]\[Lucky Title Page] appropriately nerfed[/p][/*][*][p]\[Attack Speed] property cap set at 300 - excess values will be converted to equivalent attack power[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]​[b]​+ Spell Adjustments[/b]​[/p][list][*][p]\[Sands of Time] nerfed to 0.02s per rock kill[/p][/*][*][p]\[Snowburst Crystal] adjusted to produce 1 magic crystal with reduced cooldown[/p][/*][*][p]\[Creation Bullet] now grants 3 crystals per hit but capped at 300 per battle[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]​[b]​+ Other Changes[/b]​[/p][list][*][p]Experience thresholds will now continue increasing beyond level 20[/p][/*][*][p]\[Betrayal of the Silver Hand] mythic effect reduced to 0.01s per shot[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Another buttery-smooth update fixes
notes.content:
+道具灌注星星时，对比提升的部分用金色文字下划线标注出

+修复了购买增加属性的道具后，部分属性条目数字没有更新的问题

notes.title: Buttery-smooth update fixes
notes.content:
+不常见的关卡后奖励节点增加了详细的效果描述
+增加玩家受伤时的屏幕闪红反馈
+调整了第六关首领的数值符合难度
+修正了【二元硬币】的关卡描述多了一个中括号的问题
+修正了战斗内改变天气后，左上角的天气图标没有实时改变的问题
+修正了开档时出现上个周目锁住道具的问题
+调整【攻击】属性，现在不仅提供百分比加成，还能在每20点提供1固定伤害加成（基础伤害为1的攻击魔法现在站起来啦！）
+增加更多大波敌人来袭
+护盾格挡时，如果完全抵挡伤害，则会弹出【完美格挡】文字
+完美格挡时屏幕会有闪白反馈
+现在最终boss战斗也会出现死神收割，不能再无限拖延时间啦
+胜利评估中去掉命中率，改为击杀率，放宽评级标准
+【奥术学校】学院的lv10效果改为：每当大波敌人和首领出现时，刷新所有魔法cd
+创建角色面板中返回主菜单时，再次创建角色会保留已经作出的选择而不是清空重选
+环绕光子魔法加强
+射击时书本的blingbling动画不会停止

Happy gaming, everyone!
